statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. NQ is closed; Gulf escalation and Friday's rates repricing keep Stress extreme without live evidence of persistent one-way Nasdaq structure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The 22:00 UTC Globex reopening is the next direct price-path checkpoint; higher forecast Tail remains conditional on failed repair and repeated directional extension.
headline: Nasdaq Tail remains WATCH 24 before Sunday Globex reopening
body: NQ remains closed. Sunday Gulf headlines keep geopolitical Stress extreme, while Friday's strong-jobs yield repricing is unresolved. Shared Finviz context collected at 19:37 UTC is fresh but latest-session only; strong semiconductor breadth and weaker megacap breadth are conflicting context, not live NQ persistence evidence.

lookbackSummary: 20:00 UTC Saturday-19:00 UTC Sunday: Tail stayed in WATCH, briefly eased to 21-23 overnight, then returned to 24 as Gulf escalation risk persisted while NQ remained closed.
outlookSummary: Tail remains below blocking levels while NQ is closed. Conditional Tail reaches 34 at the 22:00 UTC reopening only if a directional gap resists repair with shallow or failed retracements and reinforcing oil/yield pressure; Labor Day liquidity can amplify noise without proving persistent Tail.
